dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior end.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium grey tone distributed uniformly across the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single, clear vertical linear indentation is visible along the posterior midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear superficial marks are visible on the dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a dark, elliptical aperture on the anterior dorsal surface.
